claims.$comment: Author-attached RRP-0019 reproducibility manifests (claim.reproducibility per claim.schema.json). NOTE: as of rrxiv-python HEAD (2026-07-14) neither the parser's meta-merge (authors + id_slug only) nor the server's submission path consumes claim patches from rrxiv-meta.json, and RRP-0030 explicitly deferred manifest-authoring aids — so this block is a declarative record wiring claim ids to the manifest files under repro/, pending a protocol authoring path. manifest_uri is pinned to the v5 tag, cut at the v5 submission pass. manifest_hash is the sha256 of the manifest file's bytes at that tag.
